title: Gold Fell 10.8% in ONE Day. What Happened? #shorts
description:
On January 30, 2026, COMEX gold futures fell 10.8%, the worst day in ten years of data, a day after a record close of $5,318. That day Kevin Warsh was named as the pick for Fed chair and the dollar rose. Silver futures fell 31%.
Full video on the Coin Theory channel.

Data: Yahoo Finance daily closes (GC=F, SI=F); FRED DTWEXBGS.
